programmes.d: Turmoil in an African country forces President Kirkman to rely on an unlikely ally for help.
As Kirkman releases an agenda, Alex makes a controversial public statement that threatens to derail it.
President Kirkman forms an unlikely alliance in the hopes of passing his first bill.
As President Kirkman struggles to put together a new Supreme Court, FBI Agent Hannah Wells goes undercover.
As Kirkman considers candidates for Vice President, Kimble Hookstraten finds herself embroiled in scandal.
The White House gears up for President Kirkman's first international summit.
Kirkman's first international summit is derailed when journalist Abe Leonard publishes an explosive article.
Hannah Wells must stop a final attack while President Kirkman authorizes a nationwide manhunt.
Kirkman is a Commander-in-Chief determined to capture the terrorists behind the catastrophic attack.
